risks.title: Critical accounting estimates and inaccuracies
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of Item 1A (strong position). Moderate intensity language (could differ materially). Stable trend, recurring each year. Capital category heavily weighted as it directly affects financial statements and asset valuations

risks.title: Asset impairment and goodwill of $9.35 billion
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in the middle of the section with concrete figures ($9.35 billion goodwill). Moderate language (may not be recoverable). Stable trend but substantial amount. Critical Capital category as it represents 15-20% of typical major oil company assets

risks.title: Volatility of commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk exposed at the end of Item 7A with explicit language (exposed to market risks). Moderate intensity (could materially affect). Stable trend but structural to the sector. Macro category heavily weighted for an integrated oil company

risks.title: Assumptions on future volumes and customer demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in the middle of the section with uncertain language (inherently subjective and contingent). Stable trend but recognized as difficult to forecast. Industrial category as it directly affects refining and midstream operations

risks.title: Equity method investments ($6.80 billion)
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in the middle with specific amount ($6.80 billion). Moderate language (other than temporary loss). Stable trend. Capital category as it represents approximately 10% of assets and depends on performance of non-controlled entities

risks.title: Discount rate risk and pension obligations
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed with quantified sensitivities (0.25% decline: +$75 million obligations). Technical language but material impact. Stable trend but sensitive to interest rates. Capital category as it affects the balance sheet and pension charges

risks.title: Uncertainties on acquisitions and fair value
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in the middle with uncertain language (inherently uncertain, may differ materially). Stable trend but recurring. Capital category as it affects post-acquisition valuations and goodwill
